QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Icarus, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to greet #b#p407##k, a resident of the city. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the cityspeople is a given, right? \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I greeted #p407#, a resident of #m10003000#. As expected, the residents of this city seem to be quite full of personality.

0.0: "There isn't a whole lot you're forced to do as a resident of #m10003000#, but hey, if you're up for it, I'd highly recommend chatting with the locals around here. Come to think of it, it would be a good idea to go say hi to #p407# as well.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: Look at that sky... Isn't it just beautiful? I could literally stare at the sunset all day long... Wait, who are you?
1.1: Ah, so you're the new resident of this city. Cool. I'll let you in on the absolute best thing about this place. A lot of people call #m10003000# a gray city, but I think they're totally wrong. #m10003000# is a red city with the most beautiful sunset in the entire world.
1.2: Standing up here so high and looking at the sky makes me imagine myself flying through the air. Wouldn't that be amazing? Someday, I'm definitely gonna find a way to do it.

level.0: But you... your level is, like, way too low?
